privacy_page.label: Legal
privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.description: How Actx0 collects, uses, and protects personal data.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: Actx0 ("Actx0", "we", "us", or "our") provides memory infrastructure for AI agents and applications. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you visit actx0.com or use our cloud services, websites, APIs, and related products (the "Services").
Questions about this policy: hello@actx0.com.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect information in the following categories:
list: Account information: name, email address, authentication identifiers, and workspace details you provide when you register or manage a team.
Billing information: payment and subscription details processed by our payment providers. We do not store full card numbers on our servers.
Customer content: conversations, documents, memories, embeddings, and other data you or your agents send to the Services ("Customer Content").
Usage and device data: IP address, browser type, pages viewed, referring URLs, approximate location derived from IP, and product usage events needed to operate and secure the Services.
Cookies and similar technologies: essential cookies for sign-in and security, plus optional preference and analytics cookies when you consent.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use information to:
list: Provide, maintain, and improve the Services, including memory storage, retrieval, and related APIs.
Authenticate users, secure accounts, prevent abuse, and enforce our Terms of Use.
Process payments, manage subscriptions, and send service-related notices.
Respond to support requests and communicate about product updates when appropriate.
Understand aggregate usage and performance (including via Google Analytics, Vercel Web Analytics, and Speed Insights when analytics cookies are accepted).
Comply with law and protect the rights, safety, and property of Actx0, our users, and the public.

sections.heading: 4. Customer Content
paragraphs: You (or your organization) control Customer Content. We process Customer Content to provide the Services you request and as described in your agreement with us.

We do not sell Customer Content. We do not use Customer Content to train public foundation models. Access by Actx0 personnel is limited to what is needed for support, security, abuse prevention, and service operations, subject to confidentiality controls.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing of information
paragraphs: We may share information with:
list: Service providers who help us host, process payments, send email, monitor infrastructure, or analyze product usage under contractual confidentiality and data-protection obligations.
Workspace admins and members according to the roles and access keys configured in your account.
Authorities when required by law, legal process, or to protect vital interests.
A successor entity in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, with notice where required.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
paragraphs: Essential cookies are required for authentication, security, and core platform features. Preference and analytics cookies are optional and only set when you accept them via our cookie banner or settings.
You can change cookie choices at any time using Cookie settings in the website footer.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
paragraphs: We retain account and billing records for as long as your account is active and as needed for legal, tax, and accounting purposes. Customer Content is retained according to your workspace configuration and retention settings until you delete it or close your account, subject to backup and legal hold exceptions.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: We implement administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we encourage strong account hygiene and careful handling of API keys.

sections.heading: 9. International transfers
paragraphs: We may process information in countries other than where you live. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers.

sections.heading: 10. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export personal data, object to or restrict certain processing, and withdraw consent. To exercise these rights, email hello@actx0.com. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.heading: 11. Children
paragraphs: The Services are not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has provided us personal data, contact us and we will take appropriate steps.

sections.heading: 12. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version on this page and update the "Last updated" date. Material changes may be communicated by email or in-product notice where appropriate.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
paragraphs: Actx0 privacy inquiries: hello@actx0.com.

shared.disclaimer: These pages describe agents you can build with session memory and workspace knowledge. Actx0 does not include helpdesk, CRM, EHR, or channel connectors.

customer_support.meta_title: AI Memory for Customer Support | Actx0
customer_support.meta_description: Give support agents session memory so they can retrieve ticket context instead of stuffing the whole thread into every prompt.
customer_support.label: Customer Support
customer_support.hero_subtitle: Store each conversation in a session. Search memories before the next reply so the agent picks up the last useful fact.
customer_support.demo_user: Please use 555-346-0123 on my account from now on.
customer_support.demo_agent: Saved as a session preference. I'll use that number on this ticket.
customer_support.problem_1_text: Customers re-explain issues agents already have in the thread, wasting time on both sides.
customer_support.problem_2_text: If you open a new session per channel, the previous facts are not there unless you map them onto the same session.
customer_support.problem_3_text: Replaying the full transcript burns tokens and still misses the one fact that matters.
customer_support.feature_1_text: Keep messages and extracted facts on the ticket session so you can search them later.
customer_support.feature_2_text: Extraction turns a useful user turn into a short memory you can retrieve on the next reply.
customer_support.feature_3_text: Point chat, email, or voice at the same session id if you want shared context. Connectors are yours to build.
customer_support.feature_4_text: Upload FAQs and policies once, then search those documents alongside session memories.
customer_support.benefit_1_text: Search session memories and knowledge chunks instead of stuffing every ticket into the prompt.
customer_support.benefit_1_item_1: Memory lives on the session, not in the context window
customer_support.benefit_1_item_2: Return a small set of matching facts per reply
customer_support.benefit_1_item_3: Long threads stay searchable without a full replay
customer_support.benefit_2_text: Write the user turn, then search before you generate. Works with the helpdesk or chatbot you already run.
customer_support.why_1_text: Search past issues and resolutions stored on that session, instead of digging through a raw log.
customer_support.why_2_title: One Session If You Map It
customer_support.why_2_text: Reuse the same session id across channels in your app. Actx0 does not ship channel connectors.
customer_support.why_3_text: Hand off inside one session so messages and memories stay together.
customer_support.why_4_text: Search workspace knowledge for policies and FAQs. Cross-customer pattern mining is not included.
customer_support.why_5_text: Optional inactivity retention on sessions. You decide what to keep.
customer_support.why_6_text: Add memory with a few API calls. No support-flow rebuild required.

sales.meta_title: AI Memory for Sales & CRM | Actx0
sales.meta_description: Give a sales agent session memory for stakeholders, objections, and commitments. You still own the CRM.
sales.label: Sales & CRM
sales.hero_subtitle: Store deal facts on a session, then search them before the next call. Actx0 is the memory layer — not a CRM replacement.
sales.demo_user: They mentioned budget approval happens in Q3. Can we follow up then?
sales.demo_agent: Saved on this deal session. I'll recall the Q3 budget window on the next search.
sales.problems_title: Why Deals Die in the CRM
sales.problem_1_text: Reps re-discover the same objections and politics instead of advancing the deal.
sales.problem_2_text: When ownership changes, the relationship context walks out the door with the last rep.
sales.problem_3_text: The nuance from calls and emails never makes it into structured fields, if it gets logged at all.
sales.features_title: Deal Memory You Attach to a Session
sales.feature_1_text: Write who cares about what as session memories, then retrieve them before the next call.
sales.feature_2_text: Search past concerns stored on the deal session instead of scanning old notes.
sales.feature_3_text: Budget windows and follow-ups persist when you store them as memories — Actx0 does not scrape your CRM.
sales.feature_4_text: Put retrieved memories into your prompt so drafts can reference prior conversations.
sales.benefit_1_text: Capture useful turns as messages so Actx0 can extract facts, then search them at call time.
sales.benefit_1_item_2: Surfaces matching memories at query time
sales.benefit_2_text: Call the API from existing sales workflows. There is no Salesforce or HubSpot connector.
sales.benefit_2_item_2: Session-scoped memory per deal or account
sales.why_title: Close With the Facts You Stored
sales.why_1_text: Objections, milestones, and preferences — one search away if they live on that session.
sales.why_2_text: A new owner can read the same messages and memories. They still need a CRM record.
sales.why_3_text: Keep using the same session id across weeks. Memories do not automatically jump to other deals.
sales.why_4_text: Search memories from your app when you want a reminder. Stalled-deal alerting is not a product feature.
sales.why_5_text: Store budget windows as facts, then retrieve them when you prepare the next outreach.
sales.why_6_text: Layer onto your CRM and sales tools. No rip-and-replace.

healthcare.meta_title: AI Memory for Care Operations | Actx0
healthcare.meta_description: Give scheduling and intake assistants session memory for preferences and prior conversations. Not an EHR or clinical safety system.
healthcare.label: Healthcare
healthcare.hero_subtitle: Use Actx0 as session memory for scheduling and intake bots. It is not an EHR, and it is not a clinical safety or allergy-alert product.
healthcare.demo_user: I prefer morning appointments and a reminder the day before.
healthcare.demo_agent: Saved on this session. I'll look for morning slots and a day-before reminder.
healthcare.problems_title: Why Assistants Feel Like Starting Over
healthcare.problem_1_text: Callers re-state scheduling preferences on every portal login and phone tree.
healthcare.problem_2_text: What happened last time rarely shapes this interaction unless you stored it.
healthcare.problem_3_text: Without memory, every caller gets the same script instead of the facts from this session.
healthcare.feature_1_text: Store communication and scheduling preferences as session facts, then retrieve them.
healthcare.feature_2_text: Do not use Actx0 as the system of record for allergies, medications, or clinical decisions.
healthcare.feature_3_text: Search previous turns on the same session when preparing the next reply.
healthcare.feature_4_text: Workspaces and access keys isolate teams. Session TTL is optional inactivity cleanup, not a PHI policy engine.
healthcare.benefit_1_text: Workspace isolation, audit logs, and scoped keys. You still need your own compliance program.
healthcare.benefit_2_text: Add session memory to triage or scheduling agents you already run. No EHR replacement.
healthcare.benefit_2_item_2: One session per conversation you choose to map
healthcare.why_title: What This Is — and Is Not
healthcare.why_1_text: Preferences and prior turns, available when you search that session.
healthcare.why_2_text: Allergies and contraindications belong in your clinical systems, not as implied product features.
healthcare.why_3_text: Portal, phone, and chat share memory only if your app uses the same session id.
healthcare.why_4_text: The model uses whatever memories you retrieve. It does not become a care plan.
healthcare.why_5_text: Session cleanup is an inactivity setting. It is not healthcare retention policy.
healthcare.why_6_text: Add memory to assistants without replacing your EHR stack.

education.meta_description: A tutor that remembers what clicked last time. Adaptive learning memory for student pace, style, and progress.
education.label: Education
education.hero_title: A Tutor That Actually Remembers You
education.hero_subtitle: Store what clicked last time on the student session, then retrieve it before the next lesson.
education.demo_user: I'm stuck on this calculus problem.
education.demo_agent: You learn best with visual examples. Let's try a diagram for this concept.
education.problems_title: Why Most Tutors Feel the Same
education.problem_1_text: The agent forgets what the student struggled with or nailed last session.
education.problem_2_text: Without memory, tutoring can't adapt to how this student actually learns.
education.problem_3_text: Real skill-building needs continuity that a single session can't provide.
education.feature_1_text: Remembers whether a student prefers examples, diagrams, or step-by-step explanations.
education.feature_2_text: Recall concepts the student said they mastered or still struggle with — if those facts were stored.
education.feature_3_text: Use retrieved memories to adjust difficulty. Actx0 does not score mastery on its own.
education.feature_4_text: Reuse the same session so later lessons can search earlier facts.
education.benefit_1_text: Give every student a tutor that remembers them without manual profile management.
education.benefit_1_item_3: Lower token use when you retrieve facts instead of the full transcript
education.benefit_2_text: Integrate memory into LMS bots, tutoring apps, and study assistants.
education.why_1_text: Diagrams, examples, or step-by-step. The tutor remembers what works for this student.
education.why_2_text: Each lesson can pick up prior facts when you keep the same session.
education.why_3_text: Knows what's solid and what needs another pass — when those facts live on the session.
education.why_4_text: Your tutor agent can adjust difficulty from retrieved facts. Actx0 does not grade the student.
education.why_5_text: Context that spans a semester, not just a single chat window.
education.why_6_text: Add memory to tutoring apps and study bots without rebuilding your platform.

devtools.meta_title: AI Memory for DevTools & Coding Agents | Actx0
devtools.meta_description: Your coding agent forgets conventions between sessions. Actx0 remembers codebase context, decisions, and team standards.
devtools.label: DevTools
devtools.hero_title: Coding Agents That Don't Forget the Rules
devtools.hero_subtitle: Conventions, architecture decisions, and codebase context, persisted across sessions so your agent stays on-pattern.
devtools.demo_user: We use pnpm workspaces and prefer functional components. Stick to that.
devtools.demo_agent: On it. Functional components in the dashboard package, pnpm workspace layout.
devtools.problems_title: Why Coding Agents Lose the Plot
devtools.problem_1_text: Agents re-introduce patterns the team already rejected or ignore project standards.
devtools.problem_2_text: Large codebases exceed what fits in a single prompt, causing inconsistent output.
devtools.problem_3_text: Architecture choices and trade-offs discussed in prior sessions vanish.
devtools.feature_1_text: Remembers lint rules, folder structure, naming patterns, and team preferences.
devtools.feature_2_text: Surfaces prior architecture choices and why they were made.
devtools.feature_3_text: Retrieves the most relevant memories instead of stuffing the full repo into prompts.
devtools.feature_4_text: Picks up where the last session left off without re-explaining the codebase.
devtools.benefit_1_text: Store conventions and decisions as memories instead of repeating them every turn.
devtools.benefit_1_item_3: Two API calls around your model
devtools.benefit_2_text: Scoped memory per session, with workspace knowledge for shared docs.
devtools.why_1_text: Lint rules, folder structure, naming, remembered so the agent stops fighting your standards.
devtools.why_2_text: Prior trade-offs and why they were made, surfaced when the agent needs them.
devtools.why_3_text: Pick up a long task tomorrow without re-explaining the entire codebase.
devtools.why_4_text: Retrieve what matters instead of stuffing the full repo into every prompt.
devtools.why_5_text: Every developer's agent aligned to the same project standards.
devtools.why_6_text: Review memory writes and retrievals in workspace audit logs.

ecommerce.meta_description: Shoppers shouldn't re-explain size and style every visit. Personal memory for recommendations that actually land.
ecommerce.label: E-Commerce
ecommerce.hero_subtitle: Size, style, budget, purchase history, remembered across visits so recommendations feel personal, not generic.
ecommerce.demo_user: Show me jackets from this brand.
ecommerce.demo_agent: You usually wear size M in this brand. Want me to filter for that?
ecommerce.problem_1_text: Shoppers re-explain size, style, and budget like they've never been here before.
ecommerce.problem_2_text: Without memory, suggestions ignore what they've bought, returned, or said they love.
ecommerce.problem_3_text: Order questions and product issues start from zero across chat, email, and app.
ecommerce.feature_1_text: Recalls sizing across brands and past returns or exchanges.
ecommerce.feature_2_text: Remembers colors, categories, and brands a shopper prefers or avoids.
ecommerce.feature_3_text: Surfaces relevant prior orders when answering questions or suggesting items.
ecommerce.feature_4_text: Carry context across chat, email, and in-app support when your app reuses the same session id.
ecommerce.benefit_1_text: Personalized agents reduce repetitive questions and surface better recommendations.
ecommerce.benefit_1_item_3: Works across support and sales agents
ecommerce.benefit_2_text: Add memory to concierge bots, support agents, and recommendation flows.
ecommerce.why_1_text: Sizing across brands, plus returns and exchanges. No more guesswork.
ecommerce.why_2_text: Colors, categories, and brands they love, and the ones they don't.
ecommerce.why_3_text: Past purchases surface when answering questions or making suggestions.
ecommerce.why_4_text: Chat, email, and in-app support share memory only if you map them to one session.
ecommerce.why_5_text: Every interaction sharpens recommendations, without manual profile work.
ecommerce.why_6_text: Add memory to concierge bots and support agents in an afternoon.
